Title: Site power supply failed in the storm
Update: Takes down Bunbury 70 cm and the Peel to South West link. Replacement supply on hand; site visit booked for Thu 12 Nov.

Title: Low and distorted audio on the input
Update: Four reports from mobiles south of the river. Keeper checking the duplexer this weekend.

Title: Link drops out in hot afternoons
Update: Linked overs from Mandurah break up after 2 pm on warm days. Antenna alignment check planned.

Title: Antenna replacement: off air 8 am to 2 pm Sun 8 Nov
Update: New antenna going up on the tower. Use simplex 146.500 while it's down.

Title: Beacon off air for a new keyer
Update: New keyer being built; back on air in about two weeks.

Title: IRLP connection drops for a few minutes in the evenings
Update: The repeater itself is fine. Router replaced on 4 Nov; watching to see if the drop-outs stop.

Title: No signal reports for a month
Update: Is it still on air? Any local amateur who can key it up and report back is a great help.

Title: Timeout timer cutting overs at 60 seconds
Update: Timer reset to 3 minutes on 30 Oct. Thanks to everyone who reported it.

Title: Link down after a firmware update
Update: Rolled back to the previous firmware on 16 Oct.
